questions.question: How should I land the upgrades you approve below?

options.label: One PR each (Recommended)
options.description: Easy to revert one at a time.

options.label: One PR for all
options.description: Faster to review, harder to bisect.

questions.question: Which of these major upgrades should I apply? Nothing is approved until you say so.

items.label: typescript 6.0 → 7.0
items.detail: The Go port. vue-tsc doesn't support it yet.

items.label: eslint 9 → 10
items.detail: Flat config only; we already use it.

items.label: zod 4 → 5
items.detail: Not released yet; this would be the beta.
